traps: the only manifest is three folders deep (platform/services/billing/Cargo.toml): a reader that looks only at the root, or one level down, finds no unit
rust-toolchain.toml sits at the repository root, far from the crate: rustup finds it by walking up from the crate's folder, so it applies
Cargo.lock version 4 lists only the crate itself: it has no dependencies
platform/ and platform/services/ are plain folders, not a Cargo workspace
edition 2021 is a language edition, not a toolchain version
